rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: 30 m school-front kerb with bus stop and flats 10-12 m away.
reasons: School no-stopping and bus zone signs
Narrow kerb between hedges and bus shelter

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks 10 m and 12 m from the kerb along the section; school grounds on the same side.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is fronted by a bus shelter and hedges; signs restrict stopping on the whole stretch.
drivers.traffic: Short approach to a junction beside a school; heavy at drop-off and pick-up.
drivers.convention: Bus zone plus No Stopping 7:30am-3:30pm on school days and No Parking times; no overnight custom.

sun_shade: Hedges and a large tree shade the south end; the rest is open to the afternoon sun from the west.
